measure: Average cost of one data breach
how_to_size: chance of a major breach a year x cost of one breach
region: Middle East (incl. Saudi Arabia and UAE)
source: IBM Cost of a Data Breach Report
notes: Average across sizes and sectors; lost business (SAR 11.6m) is inside this figure - do not add downtime on top

measure: Average cost of one data breach (global)
how_to_size: chance of a major breach a year x cost of one breach
source: IBM Cost of a Data Breach Report
notes: Use A01 for GCC entities; global figure only for comparison

measure: Extra breach cost from security system complexity
how_to_size: number of security tools retired; annual licence and run cost removed
source: IBM Cost of a Data Breach Report
notes: Supports a consolidation case; the Group's own licence and run cost is the value claim

how_to_size: outage hours a year x revenue or operating cost per hour
anchor_value: Over USD 300k an hour for over 90% of mid-size and large enterprises; USD 1m to over 5m for 41%
source: ITIC Hourly Cost of Downtime Survey
notes: Survey of enterprises; size the Group figure by business unit revenue per hour

measure: Average cost to correct one payroll error
how_to_size: payroll errors a month x cost to correct each
anchor_value: USD 291 per error; 1 in 5 payrolls has errors; average 15 corrections per payroll period
notes: US labour costs; use the Group's own error count and HR/payroll time per correction

measure: Annual cost of poor data quality
how_to_size: rework hours from bad data x cost per hour; plus decisions or revenue lost
notes: Directional only; average organisation size not stated

how_to_size: regretted leavers a year x replacement cost
notes: (dated: 2019) use Group attrition and salary bands

measure: Cost per customer service contact - assisted vs self-service
how_to_size: contacts a month moved to self-service x (assisted cost - self-service cost)
notes: (dated: 2019) same source found only 9% of customers fully resolve in self-service

measure: Technology budget lost to tech debt
how_to_size: share of change budget spent on tech debt x annual change budget
anchor_value: Tech debt is 20-40% of technology estate value; 10-20% of new-product tech budget diverted to it

measure: Sales at risk from bad customer experiences
how_to_size: customers with a bad experience a year x share who cut spending (47%) x average annual spend per customer
anchor_value: UAE: USD 16bn of sales at risk (6.7% of consumption); consumers cut spending after 47% of bad experiences
source: Qualtrics XM Institute Consumer Experience Trends
notes: National consumer figure; size the Group from its own complaint and churn data

measure: Cost of poor quality (rework scrap errors delays)
how_to_size: annual operating cost of the process x share lost to rework and errors
anchor_value: 10-15% of operations in a thriving company; quality-related costs up to 15-20% of sales revenue
notes: (undated guidance) Rule of thumb from a quality body; replace with measured rework time

how_to_size: expected disruptions per decade x share of annual EBITDA lost per disruption
anchor_value: Month-long disruptions every 3.7 years on average; shocks erase about 40-45% of one year's EBITDA over a decade
source: McKinsey Global Institute - Risk resilience and rebalancing in global value chains
notes: (dated: 2020) industry averages across manufacturing value chains

measure: Cost of non-compliance vs compliance (data protection)
how_to_size: open findings or breaches x penalty and remediation cost; compare with cost of the compliance programme
anchor_value: Non-compliance USD 14.82m vs compliance USD 5.47m on average
notes: (dated: 2017) data protection only; use the Group's regulator penalties and audit findings

how_to_size: staff affected x hours a week spent searching x share recoverable
anchor_value: Nearly 20% of the workweek spent searching for information; 20-25% productivity uplift potential for interaction workers
source: McKinsey Global Institute - The social economy
notes: (dated: 2012) capacity released stays CR unless redeployed

measure: Share of work activities automatable with current technology
how_to_size: hours a year in the process x share automatable x adoption rate
anchor_value: Activities taking 60-70% of employees' time are technically automatable
source: McKinsey - The economic potential of generative AI
notes: Technical potential not realised savings; never use as the value claim without an adoption rate

how_to_size: cases handled a year x 14% more resolved per hour x cost per hour
anchor_value: 14% more issues resolved per hour on average; 34% for novice and low-skilled agents
notes: One firm and one task; strongest evidence for assisted service work
